simple.summary: נָקַט (nâqaṭ) means to loathe First listed occurrence: Job 10 1.

definitions.full: H5354. naqat [ קוּט ] verb feel a loathing (|| form of קוּץ q. v.); — Qal Imperfect 1singular בְּדוֺר אָקוּט Psa 95:10 I felt a loathing at the Generation. Niph`al Perfect 2masculine plural consecutive בִּפְנֵיכֶם וּנְקֹטֹתֶם Ezek 20:43 ye shall feel loathing against your faces (at yourselves), with ב of thing, so 36:31 ( עַל of thing); metaplastic (as if from קטט ) 3 plural consecutive בִפְנֵיהֶם וְנָקֹטוּ 6:9 ( אֶל of thing, for עַל , + ל of thing, for which Co בְּ Krae בְּ or עַל ); also 3 feminine singular בְּ נַפְשַׁי נָָֽקְטָה Job 10:1 (as if from נ֗֗֗קט ; on both forms see Ges §§ 67dd , 72dd). Hithpolel id. Imperfect 1singular בְּ אֶתְקוֺטָט Psa 139:21 (We אֶתְקוֺמֵם ); absolute וָאֶתְקוֺטָ֑טָה 119:158 . — Ezek 16:47 see קָט ; Job 8:14 see following
